android.desc:
Tired of looking up resistor color codes? Using this app, you can get the resistance using your phone camera! 

Features:
- Automatic detection: No aligning of the resistor needed*, the app locates it automatically and analyses the rings
- Live detection
- Manual adjustment: Not the correct rings found? Tap and hold to correct them
- Manual mode: Choose the ring-colors and get the resistance
- Detect multiple resistors at once
- Brightness and zoom sliders
- Touch to focus
- Load image from gallery

If there are issues, please send me a mail (attach screenshots)

* in the free version, resistors need to be placed horizontally
